dialogues.speaker: Makani
dialogues.text: *sob* Why is no one playing Bumper Ball... Why is everyone at the Circular Arena Dodge Contest instead...?

dialogues.speaker: Makani
dialogues.text: We're right next to each other... and we even use the same props! I don't understand what we're doing wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Makani
dialogues.text: Maybe our sign isn't eye-catching enough... Perhaps the visitors don't even notice us?

dialogues.speaker: Makani
dialogues.text: What if we gave the sign a bright splash of color? A makeover, maybe...
